subject.title: [RE-OPEN REQUEST] Indexing sync failure for jjr-iot-skill (Previous #2047)

question: Does the production `janeXlab` publisher and `jjr-iot-skill` record satisfy every ownership, version, scan, moderation, deletion, and audit gate required for public detail and search visibility?
rationale: Only privileged production state can distinguish a broken synchronization from intentional suppression, and restoring visibility without that determination could bypass a security or moderation boundary.

options.title: Repair canonical visibility
options.body: If every trust gate passes, rebuild the canonical public and derived search state, then verify both detail endpoints and both reported search terms.

options.title: Preserve suppression with recovery
options.body: If any trust gate fails, keep the skill non-public and provide the publisher a specific in-product recovery or appeal path without exposing sensitive moderation internals.

recommendation.title: Repair canonical visibility
recommendation.body: If every trust gate passes, rebuild the canonical public and derived search state, then verify both detail endpoints and both reported search terms.

likelyOwner.reason: They already investigated account verification and have the strongest recent ownership signal across the affected detail, search, scan, and publish-finalization paths.
